rights_scope.exclusivity: Exclusive only for the specified products, territories, and channels while the annual purchase threshold is met; the grant becomes non-exclusive after an uncured shortfall. The grantor retains direct sales to national metrology agencies in Denmark and Sweden.
rights_scope.sublicensing: No subdistributor may be appointed without prior written consent. Approved retail stores may resell only after prior written approval and under written terms preserving the clause's limits.

source_clause: Beginning on the Launch Date, Lattice Harbor Instruments Ltd. grants Northmere Supply Co. the exclusive right to market, offer for sale, and distribute the Aster-4 portable air-quality monitors and replacement sensor cartridges for those monitors to end customers in Denmark and Sweden through approved brick-and-mortar electronics retailers and Northmere Supply Co.'s own online store. The exclusivity applies only to those products, territories, and channels; Lattice Harbor Instruments Ltd. may continue to sell directly to national metrology agencies in those countries. Northmere Supply Co. may not list the products on third-party online marketplaces, resell them outside the Territory, or appoint a subdistributor without Lattice Harbor Instruments Ltd.'s prior written consent. It may appoint an approved retail store only after receiving prior written approval and entering into written terms that preserve the channel and territory limits in this clause. The grant is exclusive for each Contract Year in which Northmere Supply Co. purchases at least 1,800 units. If it misses that threshold and does not cure the shortfall within 30 days after written notice, the grant continues on a non-exclusive basis.
uncertainties: The excerpt does not define the Launch Date or Contract Year, so their dates and calculation cannot be determined.
The clause does not specify how a purchase shortfall is measured if units are returned or canceled.
boundary_summary: The grant covers distribution of the two specified product categories in Denmark and Sweden through approved physical electronics retailers and Northmere Supply Co.'s own online store. It excludes third-party marketplaces and sales outside those countries. Exclusivity is conditional and does not prevent the grantor's reserved direct sales to national metrology agencies.
evaluation_question: May Northmere Supply Co. sell the Aster-4 monitors through a third-party online marketplace, and what must it do to retain exclusivity?
rights_interpretation: No. Third-party online marketplaces are expressly excluded; Northmere Supply Co. may use only approved brick-and-mortar electronics retailers and its own online store. To retain exclusivity for a Contract Year, it must purchase at least 1,800 units. If it falls short, it has 30 days after written notice to cure before the grant becomes non-exclusive. The grantor's direct sales to national metrology agencies remain permitted.

source_clause: During the term of this Agreement, Bracken Vale Learning Press grants Alder Quay Training Ltd. a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to translate the third edition of the Field Operations Handbook into Spanish, reproduce that Spanish-language edition, and distribute it solely to institutional customers located in Chile through Alder Quay Training Ltd.'s institutional learning subscription portal and print-on-demand orders. Before first distribution, Alder Quay Training Ltd. must submit the completed translation proof and obtain Bracken Vale Learning Press's written approval. Royalties are payable as specified in Schedule 2. Alder Quay Training Ltd. may engage one cloud-hosting provider and one print vendor solely to host subscriber access and fulfill print orders, respectively, under written agreements restricting each provider to those services; neither provider may independently exploit the Handbook. No other sublicensing is permitted. This license does not cover the English-language original, adaptations beyond translation, distribution outside Chile, or distribution through consumer marketplaces.
uncertainties: The excerpt does not state the Agreement's term or the royalty amount and calculation in Schedule 2.
The phrase institutional customers is not defined in the excerpt.
rights_interpretation: No. The distribution right is limited to institutional customers located in Chile, so Peru is outside the stated territory. Alder Quay Training Ltd. also cannot authorize an independent reseller: sublicensing is prohibited apart from the limited use of one hosting provider and one print vendor, neither of which may exploit the Handbook independently. Distribution is also conditioned on written approval of the translation proof before first release and payment of royalties under Schedule 2.

source_clause: For the Term, Rillstone Controls LLC grants Westmere Field Supply Ltd. the exclusive right to market and distribute TerraFlow 8 irrigation controllers and manufacturer-approved replacement probes through licensed agricultural equipment dealers in Australia and New Zealand. Westmere Field Supply Ltd. also receives a non-exclusive right to sell those products directly to commercial growers in those countries through its account team; Rillstone Controls LLC may make its own direct sales to commercial growers and appoint other direct-sales representatives. Westmere Field Supply Ltd. may appoint dealers after giving Rillstone Controls LLC at least 10 days' written notice and entering into written dealer agreements that restrict resale to the Territory and the authorized dealer channel. Dealer appointments are resale arrangements only and do not grant intellectual-property rights. No right is granted to manufacture or alter the products, export them outside the Territory, appoint subdistributors, or sell through consumer-facing online marketplaces.
uncertainties: The excerpt does not define the Term or licensed agricultural equipment dealer.
The clause does not specify whether any particular online sales channel other than consumer-facing marketplaces is authorized for direct sales.
boundary_summary: The grant covers the specified controllers and replacement probes in Australia and New Zealand. Westmere has exclusivity for the licensed-dealer channel but only non-exclusive rights for its own direct sales to commercial growers. Consumer-facing online marketplaces, exports, manufacturing, alteration, and subdistributors are outside the grant.
evaluation_question: Does Westmere Field Supply Ltd.'s exclusivity prevent Rillstone Controls LLC from selling directly to commercial growers, and may Westmere sell through consumer-facing online marketplaces?
rights_interpretation: No. Westmere Field Supply Ltd.'s exclusivity is confined to the licensed agricultural equipment dealer channel. Rillstone Controls LLC may continue direct sales to commercial growers and appoint other direct-sales representatives because Westmere's direct-sales right is non-exclusive. Westmere may not sell through consumer-facing online marketplaces, which are expressly excluded.
